nostr:
Amethyst 1.17.0 stops losing a whole subscription when a relay refuses one kind in it.

A strfry relay with a kind allowlist answered CLOSED to any REQ naming a kind it does not serve. Amethyst asks for gift wraps as kinds 1059 and 21059 in one filter, so the relay refused the lot. An account using that relay as its kind 10050 DM relay received no NIP-17 DMs and no White Noise invites, and nothing was logged.

Amethyst now reads the kind named in the CLOSED reason, strips it for that relay, and never sends a filter left empty. The same relay closed any REQ with four or more filters, which emptied Marmot group chats for accounts in four or more groups; the client now learns that cap and merges filters that differ in one field only.

Also in 1.17.0: NIP-92 imeta for profile pictures and banners, a NIP-49 decrypt that checks the Poly1305 tag instead of guessing from the plaintext, and Cordn group messaging.
